title: Typography anatomy: Ligature

spec.definition: Two or more letters joined into a single glyph.
spec.example: Common pairs: fi, fl and ff.

description: The term Ligature means: Two or more letters joined into a single glyph. Common pairs: fi, fl and ff. Knowing type anatomy helps designers judge sizing, pairing and spacing instead of guessing.
